column1: # ZAP baseline rules for the plain-HTTP boot check (ruling R13).

column3: Cookie without Secure flag: this container runs with HIDEOUT_FORCE_SSL=false
Strict-Transport-Security: this container runs over plain HTTP
Content Security Policy header not set
Authentication Request Identified: informational detection of the sign-in flow
Session Management Response Identified: informational detection of the session flow
Base64 Disclosure: CSRF tokens and nonces look like Base64
Suspicious comments: comments in bundled vendor JavaScript
Non-Storable Content: pages are deliberately no-store
Sec-Fetch-Dest header is missing: it is a request header the scanner did not send
Insufficient Site Isolation Against Spectre: COEP require-corp would need every embedded resource to opt in; no cross-origin isolation is needed
